storyscope.note: Sharp, funny, concrete details (mum, Dan's tip question, wrong coffee); honest ambiguity; ending lands perfectly.

baseline.note: Clear and honest, but listicle headers and tidy lessons make it read like advice, not a journal.

writing-skill.note: Competent and sincere but flat; familiar beats, few memorable images, ending is a plain to-do list.

merged.note: Warm, vivid images (curled card, paddock, quiet CV); slightly long and meandering, but genuinely moving.
